name: Visit Rwanda
verdict: Paid for by a government that UN experts say has 3,000–4,000 troops fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.

why.text: Visit Rwanda is the tourism brand of the Rwanda Development Board, a Rwandan government institution. UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo, and estimated that the rebels made about $800,000 a month from the coltan trade there. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.
